title: badscripthub
features:
Auto Fight -- Automatically plays combat turns using your equipped skills. No manual input needed -- just toggle and let it grind.
Instant Kill -- One-shots any PvE enemy instantly. Works through multi-stage bosses. Rewards are claimed as normal.
Always Black Flash -- Forces every hit to be a Black Flash for massive bonus damage.
Style Multiplier Boost -- Configurable multiplier applied on top of your fighting style bonus.
Auto Farm -- Spams ResolveCombat to grind fights continuously. Supports all difficulties including Special Grade Boss with custom boss names.
Auto Grade Up -- Automatically promotes your grade when eligible.
Auto Prestige -- Automatically prestiges when eligible.
Mouse Unlock -- Frees your cursor whenever the GUI is open.
Clean Reinjection -- Cleans up the previous instance before reloading, no duplicates.
